entry.title: "You're swimming against the tide making games like this": Why more developers didn't copy Firewatch's reactive storytelling
entry.summary: By the time Campo Santo were reaching the end of Firewatch's development, Chris Remo was itching to start over. "I remember feeling, 'God, if we made this exact same game again now, we could take these ideas so much further'." After Firewatch's release, Remo began giving talks about what Campo Santo were trying to do: making a game that focused not on interactivity, but reactivity. "I was hoping this model would catch on and be pushed forward and done in a more ambitious way than we did," Remo says. "There was a part of me that was hoping that Firewatch would point the way towards its own subgenre." But the ideas at the heart of Firewatch didn't spark imitators. entry.title: How to play Everwind co-op with friends
entry.summary:
Sandbox-RPG hybrid Everwind is now available on early access for PC players worldwide, and it already offers you a chance to play with your buddies.
While the game can be completely enjoyed on your own, you can play co-op with your buddies. While online gameplay has its fair share of limitations as of writing, it enables you to enjoy progression with your friends.
This guide will help you set up a co-op lobby to play Everwind.
Table of contents How to invite your friends in Everwind How to join co-op in Everwind
How to invite your friends in Everwind
For starters, you'll all need to own a copy of Everwind. Being friends on Steam is recommended, but it's not necessary at all. In Everwind, the co-op gameplay works in an old-school setup. You get to share a world with your buddies, but the game will be hosted on your end. Hence, it's important that the person with the best internet gets to host a shared session.
Screenshot by Destructoid
Assuming that's you, here's how you can invite your buddies to play with you. Create a world if you haven't done it already. If you already have a world, you can load it into your save. You can use the same save for offline and online play.
Press the Esc button, and select the "Go Online" option. The game will now switch to an open lobby, and you'll be able to get your code. Share this code with your buddies. They will then need to log in to the game and join using the code.
How to join co-op in Everwind
Screenshot by Destructoid
Whether it's you hosting a save or your friend, you/your friend will need to use the code to play together. From the main menu, pick the Join Game option. Enter the code, and you'll be able to join your friend's world. Similarly, they can use your code to join the shared world and play together.
You can also use the official Discord and other social media communities to share your code and play together with strangers from around the globe.

entry.title: Far Cry's name is very ironic, if you're an armchair etymologist
entry.summary:
During a random dictionary delve last week I learned that "explore" once meant to cry out. It comes from an old Latin word formed from the prefix "ex-", describing outwardness, and "plorare", meaning to cry or weep. Compare "implore" - to beg, cry for something - and "deplore" - to berate, 'cry of' something or somebody.
The OED explains ("ex + "planō", meaning to level off, flatten for understanding) that "explore" may originally have referred to hunters, shouting to scare up animals lurking in the area around them. Exploration was always somewhat predatory, then, perhaps a little anguished. I have to admit, I got misty-eyed on discovering all this, thinking about how this word I've written a million times in videogame reviews is a kind of silenced wail.

Slated to release on console in summer 2013, it was set in the original Star Wars era with Stormtroopers, Rebels, objective modes, team deathmatch, and maps on Tatooine and Bespin. It was also a stealth Star Wars: Battlefront revival project, pitched well before the EA DICE reboot. The devs envisaged a second game in 2014, offering vehicles and larger maps, followed by a full-blown official new Battlefront in 2015, complete with a singleplayer campaign and space dogfights.

entry.summary: When Emil Pagliarulo was growing up in South Boston, he lived in fear of Whitey Bulger: a local crime boss who had been shaped not only by street gangs but Alcatraz, and a stint in the CIA’s mind control program, MKUltra. "He was basically the boogeyman," Pagliarulo says. "He was the evil bad guy. You didn’t know where he was or even what he looked like, but you knew he was out there. I’m 10 years old, and I know this name." Decades later, as Bethesda Game Studios shifted into full production on Fallout 4, Pagliarulo drew on those memories to bring a post-apocalyptic Boston to life. Bohužel, zbývajících 80 minut je "jenom" velmi zručně sestříhaný (a do značné míry "zrekonstruovaný") záznam několika koncertů, jehož vychutnání bude velmi záviset na tom, do jaké míry je Elvis Presley vaším šálkem kávy. (Ilča 80 %)

entry.title: ScummVM has been accepted to the Google Summer of Code 2026
entry.summary: This year we are also coming with the good news: We've been accepted again to the Google Summer of Code program! So, if you love Adventure games or RPGs and would like to spend your summer with our cool team, we look forward to your application and participation. Fear not—we will provide enough handholding, explanations, and support if you can dedicate time to coding on our project, are an open-minded developer ready to learn, and do not hesitate to ask any questions. We've been doing GSoC for the last 19 years (can't believe it!), so we know the drill. A list of suggested projects can be found on this page. If you have your own idea, we will gladly evaluate it. For example, this happened in 2023 with the Crab engine which is now fully supported. The required information for your application for our project is listed on our Wiki. To give you a nice boost, we have put together an impressive amount of information on the Google Summer of Code miniportal. So you can learn all the ins and outs of the process. But indeed, you need to start by joining our Discord server and follow the #scummvm-gsoc channel where you can engage with our mentors and the rest of the team. We are looking forward to your fine application and participation! >

entry.title: Audio recenze: Parazit z chlaďáku - 50 %
entry.summary: Natočit "Kmen Andromeda" jako komedii je zajímavý nápad, ale jeho filmová realizace znatelně drhne a trvá téměř hodinu, než se film konečně trochu rozjede. Na vině je především režisér, pod jehož taktovkou značná část humoru nefunguje tak dobře, jak si scenárista představoval. Škoda, že nerežíroval třeba Sam Raimi, protože potenciál námětu byl značný. (Ilča 50 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: Otec Matka Sestra Bratr [Father Mother Sister Brother] - 60 %
entry.summary: První povídka bezva a dokonce měla něco jako pointu, což mě u Jarmusche příjemně překvapilo. Bohužel, druhá a třetí povídka mají jasnou sestupnou tendenci: Druhá nemá pointu a třetí ani děj. Pravděpodobně zůstanu u své zásady "Jeden Jarmusch za 10 let stačí". (Ilča 50 %)
